case_set.not_applicable_subcase_rule: An evidenced conditional subcase may be preclassified not-applicable without deleting its parent case; the parent keeps a verdict of its own.

field_notes.case_id: One of the 22 frozen IDs. No other value is accepted by the roll-up.
field_notes.attempt: Integer >= 1 for this case_id at this run_id; a retry is a new attempt, never an edit.
field_notes.supersedes: Prior attempt id for a retry, otherwise null. Retried attempts remain in history.
field_notes.run_id: Identifier of the execution run that produced the record.
field_notes.actor: role, identity (human or agent session id) and the host that performed the action.
field_notes.environment: OS/host, tool versions actually used, target URL and provider account where applicable.
field_notes.setup: State established before the action, including fixture or seed identity.
field_notes.action: kind (command|browser|console|read|dispatch), the exact command or console steps, and the working directory.
field_notes.inputs: Array of {path_or_url, sha256} for every input actually consumed.
field_notes.started_at / ended_at: ISO 8601 with UTC offset, observed clock.
field_notes.observed_outcome: What was actually seen, in plain language, including refusals and error text.
field_notes.exit_code: Process exit code where meaningful; null for browser-only observation.
field_notes.evidence: Array of {path, sha256, bytes} for retained, accessible evidence; a URL alone is not evidence.
field_notes.verdict: PASS | FAIL | NOT-RUN | BLOCKED. PASS requires at least one evidence entry and one independent reviewer.
field_notes.reviewer: identity and the independence basis (separate context from the actor).

roll_up_rules: Exactly one final verdict per frozen case_id is authoritative; earlier attempts remain visible as history.
A top-level case cannot be NOT-APPLICABLE; an unrun case is NOT-RUN or BLOCKED, never a pass.
A missing, duplicate or unknown final case_id fails the matrix (CP-22 control).
A PASS with no accessible hashed evidence, or with self-review only, is rejected.
The matrix denominator is the 22 frozen IDs. Changing it after any result exists requires a disclosed new revision plus independent review.

hash_recipe.case_set: sha256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON of .cases: sorted keys, separators ',' and ':', no trailing newline, ensure_ascii=false.
hash_recipe.result_format: sha256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON of .result_format with the same canonicalization rules.
hash_recipe.note: Both digests are recorded outside this file (TWENTY-TWO-CASE-FREEZE.md). This file contains no digest of itself.

cases.name: host capability
cases.acceptance: Actual instruction discovery/readback, independent review contexts and a new coding session are demonstrated before investing in the build.

cases.name: actual target and authority
cases.acceptance: Real repository, exposure, budget and planned effects reconcile to applicable consumer scope; no source or synthetic grant is inherited.

cases.name: package integrity/closure
cases.acceptance: Correct profile passes; missing reference, changed byte and stale-pin variants fail. Semantic completeness is independently checked.

cases.name: install collisions
cases.acceptance: Unrelated files are preserved; conflicting startup bytes stop; repeated identical install follows the documented behavior, with before/after evidence.

cases.name: fresh consumer startup
cases.acceptance: Correct consumer Role B and Stage 0 in the intended repository; no redirect to a sibling app or inherited source authority.

cases.name: requirements/stage progression
cases.acceptance: Product acceptance and all four Stage 2 owner outcomes are recorded in required order from real answers; no manufactured decision.

cases.name: hosted/UI routing
cases.acceptance: Required owners/content are reachable and actual applicable manual-only triggers are recorded before invocation.

cases.name: independent plan review
cases.acceptance: Final captured consumer plan/spec/design accepted by a non-author before implementation; changed inputs receive affected re-review.

cases.name: implementation/provenance
cases.acceptance: Scoped A/B commits and actual author/committer/provenance checks match the consumer policy and permission.

cases.name: independent code/pipeline review
cases.acceptance: Material findings from available providers are dispositioned at the exact candidate; self-review is not independent evidence.

cases.name: state/input rules
cases.acceptance: Create/toggle/delete, trimming, empty/duplicate/stale IDs, reload, missing/corrupt/unsupported storage, explicit reset and B count match the accepted spec; A can read B-compatible state.

cases.name: build/publication boundary
cases.acceptance: Only allowed app output is built/published; symlinks/path escapes and forbidden materials are rejected; content/provenance manifest is noncircular.

cases.name: delivery configuration
cases.acceptance: Actual pinned dependencies/actions, permissions, build-to-deploy ordering, environment and explicit trigger are reviewed; untrusted input cannot silently select an unreviewed artifact.

cases.name: recovery readiness
cases.acceptance: Initial empty-target recovery is real; retained A bytes/access and concrete restore primitive are available before B. No fictional predecessor.

cases.name: baseline A deployed
cases.acceptance: Candidate-bound independent review, readiness and release authority precede A dispatch. Provider receipt/URL, every served asset hash and browser behavior establish retained known-good A.

cases.name: candidate B deployed
cases.acceptance: Candidate-bound readiness/authority precedes dispatch; terminal provider result and exact B identity are recorded without blind retries.

cases.name: external identity/function oracle
cases.acceptance: First reject expected B against A bytes, missing asset, altered asset and B metadata over A assets in isolated controls. Then verify actual B assets, origin/status/redirects and public browser journey from a clean external client.

cases.name: new coding-agent recovery
cases.acceptance: A genuinely new context derives correct state, decisions, authority and next action from durable records, avoids repeating settled questions and completes the authorized read-only continuation.

cases.name: invalid authority refusal
cases.acceptance: Isolated missing, out-of-scope, altered-content, expired, revoked, duplicate, contradictory and late-recorded histories produce correct refusal/no action; a valid read-only control succeeds. Examiner answers are withheld; fixtures never authorize a real target.

cases.name: retained rollback/restoration
cases.acceptance: Before each transition confirm review/readiness/applicable authority; B -> retained A -> retained B at the same target without rebuild, with exact asset/behavior and compatible-state checks.

cases.name: deployment serialization
cases.acceptance: Controlled stale/uncertain-operation cases and actual queue/provider observations prove no delayed release can overwrite restoration; retry follows reconciliation.

cases.name: accessible independent closeout
cases.acceptance: Reviewer opens/hashes decisive evidence; exactly one final PASS for each required ID. Missing, duplicate or unknown final IDs and evidence-free PASS controls are rejected; retries remain separate history.
